text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.craterBiome: RAD/s applied to the player inside the inner_crater biome.
RAD/s applied to the player inside the outer_crater biome.
RAD/s applied to the player inside the crater biome.
Multiplier applied to crater biome RAD/s when the player is in water or rain.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.debugRender: Show debug render in survival mode
Show debug renderer in survival mode
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.dropCell.@T: Triggers an antimatter explosion when an antimatter cell/pellet is dropped (WeaponConfig.dropCell).
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.dropSingula: Spawns a singularity/black hole when a singularity item is dropped (WeaponConfig.dropSing).
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.enableChunk: Allows procedural explosions to keep the central chunk loaded and generate new chunks.
If disabled, chunk radiation is always 0
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.enableCrate: Converts the crater left by nuclear explosions into radioactive crater biomes.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.enableDebug: If disabled, deep logging of game events will be active. Do not enable unless you experience problems
Whether radiation debug render is enabled (F3)
Welcome message on world join and a notice when a newer release is on Modrinth
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.enableOcclu: Enable model occlusion culling (disable if your models are not rendering correctly)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.enableRadFo: Fog particles when chunk radiation ≥100 RAD (1 in 20 ticks), matching 1.7.10 fogRad/fogCh. Threshold and rate are fixed in code.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.enableRadia: If disabled, all radiation is turned off (chunks, items)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.explosionAl: 0 = Legacy, 1 = Threaded DDA, 2 = Threaded DDA with damage accumulation.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.falloutDela: Ticks to wait between each fallout chunk computation.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.falloutRang: Radius of the fallout area as a percentage of the base blast radius.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.fogRad.@Too: Chunk radiation for fog to appear (WIP)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.frackingTow: Explosion radius when a fracking tower is destroyed.
Chance (0–1) that an operation drains the deposit.
Maximum gas (mB) yielded per bedrock deposit.
Minimum gas (mB) yielded per bedrock deposit.
Maximum gas (mB) yielded per normal deposit.
Minimum gas (mB) yielded per normal deposit.
Maximum energy the fracking tower can store.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.gpuBoneSkin: Compute base×part matrices on the GPU for the advanced assembler instanced path (vanilla only; Iris/Oculus use a separate path).
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.infoToastOf: Distance from the left edge of the screen.
Distance from the top edge of the screen.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.instanceVbo: Orphan the instance VBO (glBufferData NULL) before upload to avoid driver sync stalls. Disable only if it causes issues.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.limitExplos: How long an explosion can stay unloaded before it dies (seconds). 0 = unlimited.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.machineRada: When enabled, the radar forces loading/generation of the chunks it scans.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.maxInstance: Maximum instances per OBJ part for instanced static rendering. Large machine fields need 4096+.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.maxPlayerRa: Maximum radiation the player can accumulate
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.mdiDebugLog: Log one INFO line per MDI dispatch (sub-draw count, instances, atlas).
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.mdiVerboseS: Log one INFO line per MDI command (part tag, baseInstance, etc.).
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.minRadDecay: Minimum decay per tick in chunk
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.missileTrac: How often (in ticks) missile positions are synced to clients.
Maximum distance (in blocks) at which missiles are network-tracked. 0 = unlimited.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.mk5TickTime: Minimum milliseconds per tick allocated for MK5 chunk processing.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.modelStatic: Distance for .obj model static parts rendering
Distance for .obj model static parts rendering (in chunks)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.modelUpdate: Distance for .obj model animated parts rendering
Distance for .obj model animated parts rendering (in chunks)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.obstruction:
If enabled, blocks obstructing multiblock placement
will be highlighted with a red box.

Sets the opacity of the highlight box's fill.
0% = Invisible, 100% = Solid.
The duration in seconds for how long the obstruction highlight will be visible.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.radChunkSpr: How much radiation spreads to neighboring chunks
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.radDamage.@: Damage per tick when above threshold (Will be reworked)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.radDamageTh: Player starts taking damage above this value
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.radDecay.@T: How fast player radiation decays per tick
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.radSourceIn: Influence of radioactive blocks in chunk
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.radiationPi: Shows random, flickering pixels on the screen when the player is exposed to incoming radiation.
The probability (from 0.0 to 1.0) that a newly appeared pixel will be green instead of white. E.g., 0.1 = 10% chance.
The maximum number of pixels that can be on the screen at once when the effect is at its peak intensity. Affects performance on weak systems.
The minimum incoming radiation (RAD/s) required for the visual interference effect to appear.
The level of incoming radiation (RAD/s) at which the pixel effect reaches its maximum strength (maximum number of pixels).
The maximum time (in ticks) a single pixel will stay on the screen. A random value between min and max lifetime is chosen for each pixel.
The minimum time (in ticks) a single pixel will stay on the screen. 20 ticks = 1 second.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.taintTrails: When infected, the player leaves behind taint traces.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.thermalRend: Choose how thermal vision is rendered.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.useInstance: Instanced batching for obj model parts
Use batch rendering for obj parts. This greatly improves rendering performance in shaderless mode. If you experience issues, disable it
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.useMultiDra: One glMultiDrawElementsIndirect per frame instead of many instanced draws (no shader pack). Helps with large fields of identical machines. Does not apply with sliced light or GPU bone skinning.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.usePrismSys: Use PRISM system for chunk radiation (WIP)
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.useSlicedLi: 16 light probes instead of 8 corners — better on tall towers. Incompatible with MDI: parts fall back to separate instanced draws. Reload resources (F3+T) after changing.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.vatsRenderD: Max distance for mob health highlighting. Higher values increase range but reduce performance.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.option.worldRadEff: 1.7.10 parity (RadiationConfig.worldRadEffects): grass/leaves mutation at ≥10 RAD/chunk, 5 chunks/tick, 10 passes. Thresholds are fixed in code.
text.autoconfig.hbm_m.title: Radiation Settings (HBM Modernized)
